summary: The v2 blocker and advisory are materially repaired. The authoritative requiredNow set is 18: D-002's 19 gates minus D-077-dropped G17. G03/G04 remain inside that denominator but are zero-progress reservations pending the complete D-006 naming act, so projected progress is honestly 16 of 18. G17 is inapplicable and uncounted. G13 is now an explicit zero-progress reservation gated on DR-118 in both its row and later batch. No exact machines, Rosetta substitution, qualification claim, condition-4 MET claim, implementation authorization, or file-08 edit is hidden. One stale remaining-unmet sentence retains v2's retired 'countable' terminology and imprecisely says G03/G04 must not be written as required-now names; the typed sets and effect statement resolve the meaning correctly, so this is advisory rather than blocking.

findings.title: One MF-6 instruction retains the retired countable/required-now wording
findings.claim: remainingUnmetNamed uses terminology v3 otherwise removes and can be misread as excluding G03/G04 from requiredNow.
evidence: The sentence says: 'MF-6 file-08 write of *countable* identifiers ... G03/G04/G17 must not be written as required-now names.'
V3's authorityClaim expressly rejects a 'countable required' set; sliceScope instead defines presentlyRecordableRequiredNames as a progress category only.
G03/G04 are in the authoritative 18-member requiredNow array and carry stillRequired=true. Only G17 is not required-now.

condition4EffectIfLaterRecorded correctly instructs 16 of 18 and says G03/G04 remain required and unnamed, so the dominant machine-readable and effect fields prevent the stale sentence from changing the verdict.
findings.impact: A later MF-6 author relying on the stale prose rather than the typed arrays could describe G03/G04 as outside requiredNow instead of required-but-not-yet-validly-named.
findings.recommendedRepair: Before or in the MF-6 write, replace the sentence with: 'MF-6 file-08 write of presently recordable required identifiers into the harness column. Do not write G03/G04 as named until the D-006-conforming naming act lands; do not write dropped G17 as required-now.' Remove the word countable.
